title: 第十一章 欠账增加以及护卫任务第十二章 飞龙王国一些税收法律
content_zh:
深夜。克米迪斯跟他的同伴背着已经喝醉的颜铁龙和欧斯派恩来到柔柔旅店，并进入旅店里面。
琪莉米丝在柜台看到进来的都熟人正想要问就听到在克米迪斯背后已经喝醉的颜铁龙大声嚷嚷道：“在来一杯！呵呵。”。
“克米迪斯，你到给我说说这是怎么一回事？”琪莉米迪邹着眉头看着喝醉的颜铁龙和欧斯派恩语气不满的对克米迪斯问道。
“呵呵，如你看到的他们样子，应该知道他们喝醉而已。”克米迪斯放下颜铁龙打哈哈说道。
“颜铁龙这家伙可不容易喝醉呀，他到底喝了多少酒？”琪莉米丝看着迷迷糊糊的颜铁龙，对着克米迪斯问道。
“铁龙这家伙在先前为了庆祝欧斯派恩加入他的雇佣兵团，在我酒馆里点了一大堆菜，然后喝高了。
他一个人前前后后喝了我三大桶麦酒《一桶将近二百斤左右》，在喝的兴起还请在场的客人随便喝麦酒，现在他身上全部的钱给我，还欠我五枚金币，最让我想不明白他是怎么喝下那么多酒。”克米迪斯对琪莉米丝解释道并对于颜铁龙能喝那么多酒感到佩服不已。
琪莉米丝听完克米迪斯的话，皱着眉头看着颜铁龙和欧斯派恩醉酒的样子就对身边十分强壮中年妇女吩咐道：“熊丽米恩他们二人就拜托你送入房间。”。
“好的，老板。”熊丽米恩回应后直接来到颜铁龙身边一只手将他拎了起来，然后欧斯派恩也被他另一只手拎了起来，走向属于两个醉鬼的房间去。
“琪莉米丝，我听颜铁龙喝醉后说，你将他17枚金币收走，而且还让他欠你283枚金币来赔偿你那套房子，你这样做会不会太过分了？”克米迪斯想起颜铁龙醉酒抱怨的话，神情严肃看着琪莉米丝问道。
“二年前我因为误会了颜铁龙导致他离开古羽镇让我愧疚于心，在你这里得知他回来以及要组织雇佣兵团，我十分高兴在街道之时想等一下！准备亲自下厨犒劳他，并想要用什么方法帮助他。
后来到了自己旅店我就想到组织雇佣兵团，那么他必然需要大量住宿的地方给他雇佣兵团成员，于是我就决定将陈旧的老房子拆除，重新造宿舍给颜铁龙使用。”琪莉米丝拿了一杯清水放到克米迪斯面前解释道。
“琪莉米丝，那你为什么不直接跟他说反而用这种方法，这会让他对你的感官更加差了。”克米迪斯喝了一口清水继续疑惑琪莉米丝为什么这么做。
“克米迪斯，你们对颜铁龙他们太好了，那只会害了他们，我宁愿他们恨我，我也不希望他们觉得我们为他做的事被他们认为应该的，所以请你将这一份转欠账转让协议签了。”琪莉米丝说道并将一份自己刚刚写的协议放到克米迪斯面前。
克米迪斯看了看协议没有问题就签上自己的大名并说道：“希望他们能理解你的苦心吧，可不要最后让他们记恨你啊！”。
“他们记不记恨我，我一点也不在意，我只是对了起自己的内心就行了。”琪莉米丝收起协议说道。
“琪莉米丝，天色已经不早我先回去了。”克米迪斯说完就起身离开。
“克米迪斯，颜铁龙已经不是三年前那个单纯又有心机的小家伙，他成长比你我想象中还要快，也不知道这是好还是坏。”琪莉米丝看着克米迪斯离开的身影自己嘀咕道。
第二天当太阳升起并一丝阳光照到柔柔旅店里，正在旅店前柜台琪莉米丝记账本突然听到小花园右侧住宿二层房子一声惨叫就支起羽毛笔说道：“这么快醒了，我还以为最起码要到中午才会醒。”。
“有小偷啊！琪莉米丝大婶，你们旅店里有小偷啊！”颜铁龙衣衫不整急急忙忙跑到前柜台对正在写什么的琪莉米丝大声道。

琪莉米丝面无表情的来到颜铁龙面前狠狠给他腹部一拳：“碰！”然后对周围看向颜铁龙的客人带着微笑解释道：“各位客人，真是不好意思，这家伙昨天喝了三桶麦酒到现在都还没有醒过来，在这里胡说八道，请大家放心，我这里绝对没有不开眼的小偷来我这里。”。
周围打算住店的和已经住店的客人听到琪莉米丝的保证都松了一口气，然后继续他们住店的住店，吃饭的吃饭。
“琪莉米丝不要打了，我知道错了。”颜铁龙疼的捂着自己肚子看到琪莉米丝在一次挥拳向自己就急忙承认自己的错误道，道歉道。
“看来酒醒的差不多了，那就跟我过来。”琪莉米丝看到颜铁龙求饶的样子就放弃继续教训他的打算，吩咐道。
“酒在不醒，会被打死的！”颜铁龙看到琪莉米丝放过自己就松了一口气内心害怕的想道。
“这是绿羽茜酒馆拿过来账单，我已经帮你付了，现在你把这个欠单，签上自己大名。”琪莉米丝看到颜铁龙来到柜台就将一张欠单放到他面前说道。
颜铁龙看来欠单皱起眉头不满的说道：“琪莉米丝大婶，五枚金币你是不是开玩笑啊，我在能吃也吃不了那么多啊！”。
content_en:
late at night. Kemedis and his companions carried the already drunk Yan Tielong and Ospine to the Rourou Hotel and entered the hotel.
At the counter, Kirimis saw an acquaintance coming in and was about to ask when she heard Yan Tielong, who was already drunk, shouting loudly behind Kermitis: "Here's a drink! Haha."
"Kemidis, tell me what's going on?" Chilimidi looked at the drunken Yan Tielong and Ospine with a frown and asked Kemidis in a dissatisfied tone.
"Haha, from what you saw about them, you should know that they are just drunk." Kermidis put down Yan Tielong and said haha.
"Yan Tielong doesn't get drunk easily. How much alcohol did he drink?" Qilimis looked at the confused Yan Tielong and asked Kemedis.
"This guy Iron Dragon ordered a lot of food in my tavern to celebrate Ospine joining his mercenary group, and then got drunk.
He drank three large barrels of my ale by himself (one barrel is nearly two hundred kilograms). When he was drunk, he invited all the guests present to drink the ale. Now he gave me all the money he had and still owed me five gold coins. What makes me wonder how he drank so much wine. "Kemidis explained to Qilimis and was impressed by Yan Tielong's ability to drink so much wine.
After listening to Kemedis's words, Kirimis frowned and looked at Yan Tielong and Ospine's drunk appearance, and then ordered the very strong middle-aged woman next to her: "Xiong Limien and the others, please send them to the room.".
"Okay, boss." After Xiong Limien responded, he came directly to Yan Tielong and picked him up with one hand. Then Ospine was also picked up by his other hand and walked towards the room belonging to the two drunkards.
"Qilimis, I heard Yan Tielong say when he was drunk that you took away 17 gold coins from him and made him owe you 283 gold coins to compensate for your house. Is this going too far?" Kemedis remembered Yan Tielong's drunken complaints and looked at Qilimis with a serious expression.
"Two years ago, I misunderstood Yan Tielong and caused him to leave Guyu Town, which made me feel guilty. When I learned from you that he was coming back and organizing a mercenary group, I was very happy and wanted to wait while I was on the street! I was going to cook to reward him myself, and I wanted to help him in some way.
Later, when I got to my hotel, I thought of organizing a mercenary group. Then he would definitely need a lot of accommodation for his mercenary group members, so I decided to demolish the old house and rebuild a dormitory for Yan Tielong. "Qilimis took a glass of water and put it in front of Kemedis and explained.
"Kilimis, then why didn't you tell him directly and instead used this method, which would make him feel worse about you." Kemedis took a sip of water and continued to wonder why Kirimis did this.
"Kemidis, you are too kind to Yan Tielong and the others, which will only harm them. I would rather they hate me, and I don't want them to think that what we have done for him is what they think they deserve, so please sign this debt transfer agreement." Kirimis said and put an agreement she had just written in front of Kemidis.
Kemedis saw that there was nothing wrong with the agreement, signed his name and said: "I hope they can understand your painstaking efforts, but don't let them hate you in the end!".
"I don't care at all whether they remember me or not. I just have to deal with my heart." Kirimis said as she put away the agreement.
"Kilimis, it's getting late. I'll go back first." After finishing speaking, Kemedis stood up and left.
"Kemidis, Yan Tielong is no longer the simple and scheming little guy he was three years ago. He has grown up faster than you and I imagined. I don't know whether this is good or bad." Kirimis muttered to herself as she watched Kemidis leave.
Be the sun the next dayA ray of sunlight rose and shone into the Rourou Hotel. Kirimis was keeping her account at the front desk of the hotel when she suddenly heard a scream from the second-story accommodation house on the right side of the small garden. She put up her quill and said, "I woke up so soon. I thought I wouldn't wake up until noon at least."
"There is a thief! Aunt Qilimis, there is a thief in your hotel!" Yan Tielong, disheveled, hurried to the front counter and shouted to Qilimis who was writing something.
Kirimis came to Yan Tielong with an expressionless face and punched him in the abdomen: "Touch!" Then she explained with a smile to the guests who were looking at Yan Tielong: "Dear guests, I'm really sorry. This guy drank three barrels of ale yesterday and still hasn't woken up yet. He is talking nonsense here. Please rest assured, there is absolutely no blind thief coming to my place."
The surrounding guests who were planning to stay at the hotel and those who had already stayed at the hotel breathed a sigh of relief when they heard Qilimis's assurance, and then continued to stay in the hotel and eat.
"Qilimis, don't hit me. I know I was wrong." Yan Tielong held his stomach in pain and saw Qilimis punching him once, so he hurriedly admitted his mistake and apologized.
"It seems that you are almost sober, so come with me." Seeing Yan Tielong's begging for mercy, Qilimis gave up her plan to teach him a lesson and ordered.
"You will be beaten to death if you are still drunk!" Yan Tielong thought with fear in his heart when he breathed a sigh of relief when Qilimis let him go.
"This is the bill brought over by Lu Yuqian's Tavern. I have already paid it for you. Now you sign the bill with your name." Qilimis saw Yan Tielong coming to the counter and put a bill in front of him and said.
Yan Tielong frowned and said dissatisfiedly as he seemed to be in debt: "Aunt Qilimis, are you kidding me about five gold coins? I can't eat that much even if I can!".
